resources.name: Detectron(FAIR)
resources.desc: Detectron is Facebook AI Research's software system that implements state-of-the-art object detection algorithms, including Mask R-CNN. It is written in Python and powered by the Caffe2 deep learning framework.

resources.name: Detectron2
resources.desc: Detectron2 is FAIR's next-generation research platform for object detection and segmentation.

resources.name: maskrcnn-benchmark(FAIR)
resources.desc: Fast, modular reference implementation of Instance Segmentation and Object Detection algorithms in PyTorch.

resources.name: mmdetection(SenseTime&CUHK)
resources.desc: mmdetection is an open source object detection toolbox based on PyTorch. It is a part of the open-mmlab project developed by Multimedia Laboratory, CUHK.
